name: java-analyst
description: Analysis-only task workflow for Java teams: research, interview, flow charts, findings and proposed solutions as local documents, plus optional output formats (developer guide, visual page, Confluence page). Never changes code.

dev_guide.title: Developer guide
dev_guide.description: After each analysis, also write 07-dev-guide.md: how to build the solution in this codebase - UML and sequence diagrams, the patterns to follow with real reference code, templates with TODOs for the new classes and tests. It explains; it does not write the solution.

visual_artifact.title: Visual page (Artifact)
visual_artifact.description: After each analysis, build an interactive page (recommendation, flows, requirements, options with effort and risk, the plan) and publish it as a private Artifact on claude.ai. Secrets and personal data are left out.

confluence_page.title: Confluence-style page
confluence_page.description: After each analysis, also write confluence-page.md: a plain overview for BA, PM, QA and the team, ready to paste into Confluence. Nothing is published.
